reading.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Education
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing education by personalizing learning experiences for students. AI-powered systems can analyze individual learning patterns and adapt teaching methods accordingly. Teachers can use AI tools to automate administrative tasks, allowing them to focus more on student engagement and critical thinking development. However, concerns about data privacy and over-reliance on technology remain significant challenges that educators must address carefully.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one benefit of AI in education?
options: A) It eliminates the need for teachers
B) It can personalize learning experiences
C) It reduces student anxiety completely
D) It makes exams easier to pass
questions.explanation: 지문에서 AI는 개인의 학습 패턴을 분석하여 교육 방법을 맞춤화할 수 있다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What concern is mentioned about AI in education?
options: A) It is too expensive for schools
B) It will make teachers obsolete
C) Data privacy and over-reliance on technology
D) Students will not accept AI systems
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 문장에서 데이터 프라이버시와 기술에 대한 과도한 의존이 주요 우려사항이라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: How can teachers use AI according to the passage?
options: A) To replace student learning
B) To automate administrative tasks and focus on engagement
C) To create harder exams
D) To eliminate classroom discussions
questions.explanation: 지문에서 교사들이 AI 도구를 사용하여 행정 업무를 자동화하고 학생 참여에 더 집중할 수 있다고 설명합니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement: Remote work is more productive than working in a traditional office environment. Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현: 'I strongly agree/disagree that...' 형식으로 시작하고, 본 에세이에서 논의할 주요 아이디어 2-3개를 간략히 제시합니다.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유: 원격 근무의 장점(집중력 향상, 통근 시간 절약 등) 또는 사무실 근무의 장점(협업, 팀 문화)을 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명합니다.
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유: 다른 관점에서의 생산성 차이(개인차, 업무 특성에 따른 영향, 기술 요구사항)를 상세히 논의하고 적절한 사례를 제공합니다.
structure.conclusion: 주요 주장을 재강조하며 'In conclusion, remote work/traditional office is more productive because...'로 마무리하고 제한사항이나 미래 전망을 간단히 언급합니다.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to learn new skills through online courses. Others prefer to learn through in-person classes with instructors. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer... because...
sample_points: 온라인 강좌의 유연성: 자신의 속도와 시간에 맞춰 학습할 수 있으며, 지역적 제약이 없고 다양한 강좌에 접근 가능합니다.
직접 강의의 상호작용: 강사와의 실시간 피드백, 동료 학생들과의 협력, 즉각적인 질문과 답변이 가능하여 더 깊은 이해를 도울 수 있습니다.

listening.title: Conversation: Selecting a Research Topic
listening.script:
Student: Professor, I'm having trouble choosing a topic for my research paper. I have so many ideas, but I'm not sure which one is feasible.

Professor: That's a common challenge. Let me suggest a systematic approach. First, consider your interests and expertise. What subjects do you feel passionate about?

Student: Well, I'm interested in renewable energy and climate change, but also in sustainable agriculture.

Professor: Good. Both are important topics. Now, think about available resources. Can you access sufficient research materials and data? Also consider the scope—ensure your topic isn't too broad. Climate change is vast, but sustainable agriculture in your region could be more manageable.

Student: That's helpful. So I should focus on something specific and local?

Professor: Exactly. A narrower focus makes your research more original and achievable within your timeframe. Additionally, consider practical implications. How might your research contribute to solving real problems?

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: A) To discuss climate change solutions
B) To help the student select an appropriate research topic
C) To explain renewable energy sources
D) To review completed research papers
questions.explanation: 대화의 주된 목적은 교수가 학생이 연구 주제를 선택하도록 돕는 것입니다. 교수는 체계적인 접근 방식을 제시하고 주제 선택의 기준을 설명합니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, what should students consider when choosing a research topic?
options: A) Only their personal interests
B) Only the availability of books in the library
C) Interest, available resources, scope, and practical implications
D) The professor's personal preferences
questions.explanation: 교수는 관심사, 이용 가능한 자료, 주제의 범위, 그리고 실질적 함의를 모두 고려해야 한다고 언급합니다.

questions.q: Why does the professor suggest focusing on sustainable agriculture in the student's region?
options: A) It is easier than renewable energy
B) It is more specific and manageable than broad topics like climate change
C) The student has already completed research on it
D) It requires fewer resources
questions.explanation: 교수는 지역의 지속 가능한 농업이 광범위한 주제인 기후 변화보다 더 구체적이고 관리 가능하다고 설명합니다. 이는 학생의 시간 제약 내에서 원본성 있는 연구를 가능하게 합니다.
